cohort: Mothers who underwent cesarean sections (specific population not defined)
finding: This methods paper describes three machine learning algorithms (classification and regression trees, least absolute shrinkage and selection operator, and random forest) and demonstrates their use in maternal outcomes research, specifically examining the association of oxytocin total dose exposure with primary cesarean section.
mod_finding: This study used machine learning to examine the association between oxytocin total dose exposure and primary cesarean section.
